source.preserved.meaning: Verbatim normalized supported extra source fields not owned by a core field. Migration preserves original field names/values within this object and records the explicit mapping in its preview. It never grants state/claim/approval authority.
source.preserved.writer: assigned import/routing maintainer with pinned source evidence
source.preserved.read_rule: bounded explicit field projection; no execution

unknown_namespace: INVALID_SCHEMA; preserve original input in failed-preview evidence, never drop it
new_namespace: requires maintained schema-registry change and affected review/adoption evidence
